description: Source code for the TextScan class in Apache Spark, implementing text data source scanning with schema verification, splitability checks, and configuration handling.

classes.name: TextScan
classes.description: A case class for scanning text data sources in Spark, handling schema verification, splitability, and configuration broadcasting.

methods.name: verifyReadSchema
methods.description: Checks that the read schema has only one column; throws an error if not.

methods.name: isSplitable
methods.description: Determines if a file at a given path can be split, considering the wholeText option.

methods.name: getFileUnSplittableReason
methods.description: Provides the reason why a file cannot be split, based on the splitability logic.

methods.name: createReaderFactory
methods.description: Creates a PartitionReaderFactory after verifying schema and broadcasting Hadoop configuration.
